source:
@@U04117@@
Majesty, to pledge your head,
even in so noble an endeavor,
is ill-advised, that head whose
helmet is adorned with crest and plume,
protecting it and firing your men with courage.
Without that head, what of the limbs?
When the head weakens, they all weaken.
When the head is wounded, all are wounded.
But restore it to health and all are restored.
The arm quickly shields the skull,
the sword parries and returns the blow,
and the victor plants his foot on the slain man’s neck.

@@U04119@@
My wrath exactly. It's what I'll do.
His proud head becomes my footstool.

@@U04121@@
(Returning. )

@@U04122@@
They showed us little respect and no acceptance,
scorning our noble challenge of single combat.
“That emperor of yours,” they cried,
“is an echo fading away—
a once uponatime... ”

@@U04124@@
This rebuff, Sire, cannot have been better.
The wish of your staunch supporters is fulfilled.
There comes the enemy.
Your men are eager and straining for battle.
Order the attack: the moment is right.

@@U04126@@
(To the COMMANDER-IN-CHIEEF)

@@U04127@@
I here resign all rights to the command.
Prince, I call on you to do your duty.

@@U04129@@
Then let the right wing advance!
The enemy’s left is marching up the slope.
translation:
@@U04117@@
陛下，以你的头颅作誓，
即使在如此崇高的努力中，
是不明智的，那个头
头盔上饰有徽章和羽毛，
保护它并勇敢地解雇你的人。
没有了头，四肢又如何呢？
当头部衰弱时，它们都会衰弱。
当头部受伤时，所有人都会受伤。
但恢复健康，一切都恢复了。
手臂快速护住头骨，
剑格挡并还击，
胜利者将脚踩在被杀者的脖子上。

@@U04119@@
我的愤怒正是如此。这就是我要做的。
他骄傲的头变成了我的脚凳。

@@U04121@@
（返回。）

@@U04122@@
他们对我们表现出很少的尊重和接受，
蔑视我们单打独斗的崇高挑战。
“你们那个皇帝，”他们喊道，
“是一个逐渐消失的回声——
曾几何时……”

@@U04124@@
陛下，这次拒绝再好不过了。
你们坚定支持者的愿望已经实现了。
敌人来了。
你的士兵们渴望战斗并竭尽全力。
命令进攻：时机已到。

@@U04126@@
（致总司令）

@@U04127@@
我在此放弃对命令的所有权利。
王子，我呼吁你履行你的职责。

@@U04129@@
然后让右翼前进！
敌人的左翼正在向斜坡上前进。
